prompt: Using the attached Showoff sign-in comp as the exact visual reference, create the first of two composition variations for a 1440x1000 desktop web sign-in page. Preserve its plain white background, near-black text, restrained blue action, subtle light-gray borders, typography, content, and calm SaaS identity; do not change the visual world or invent brand styling. Change only topology: use a split layout with a slim vertical account-progress rail on the left and a larger sign-in form region on the right. Put the three steps ACCOUNT, WORKSPACE, TEAM in the left rail with ACCOUNT active. Keep the form title SIGN IN TO SHOWOFF, the Google button above Apple, divider OR, labeled Email and Password, blue Continue, and Create account. This is still the first account step; do not show a signed-in user or organization. Keep mobile-stackable regions and readable control size. Visible text must be limited exactly to: SHOWOFF, ACCOUNT, WORKSPACE, TEAM, SIGN IN TO SHOWOFF, Continue with Google, Continue with Apple, OR, Email, Password, Continue, Create account. No other copy, IDs, tags, numbers, data, or labels. A clear usable interface screen, not a poster.
